script: In seahorses, it is the dad who gets pregnant. The female places her eggs in a pouch on the male's belly. He carries them until they hatch, then gives birth to the babies. In some species, a single birth can be more than a thousand babies. Seahorses are fish, even though they swim upright. Follow Pixel Abyss for more strange facts from the deep.
